meta: No more copying from a web page, pasting into the chat, then copying the result into Excel. Now Claude goes straight into those tools. Claude in Chrome is an extension; Excel and PowerPoint have add-ins.

muc.title: Copy over, paste back
muc.text: Copy from a web page, paste into the chat, then copy the result and paste it into Excel. Now Claude can go straight into those tools.

muc.title: Claude in a browser side panel
muc.text: Claude in Chrome is an extension that opens in a side panel next to your browser. It reads the page you're on, clicks buttons and moves between pages for you.

muc.title: Example: compare three stores
muc.text: For example: open three pages selling the same item, and ask it to compare price, shipping fees and warranty length.

muc.title: Payment step: do it yourself
muc.text: Because Claude clicks for you on the web, use it on sites you trust, and do the payment step yourself.

muc.title: Analyze, then build the slides
muc.text: For Excel and PowerPoint, install the Claude add-in from Microsoft Marketplace. It analyzes the numbers in Excel, then builds slides showing the results in PowerPoint, with no copying back and forth.

muc.title: Which plan?
muc.text: All three need a paid plan, Pro and up.

muc.title: Two articles, one difference
muc.text: Open two news articles about the same story, ask Claude in Chrome to sum up each in three points, then point out where they disagree.

muc.title: Build tools without knowing code
muc.text: Part 8: you can't code, but you can still make your own tools, with Claude Code.
